mutations.name: waits rank by their slowest single wait
kills: ranking waits puts the command that cost the owner the most total time first, whatever its single slowest wait

mutations.name: a wait at the budget counts as a breach
kills: ranking waits gives p50, p95 and the waits past the command's budget

mutations.name: a wait with no command is dropped
kills: ranking waits charges a wait to each command it was on, and one on none to the no-command bucket

mutations.name: a wait may name any command
kills: perf.report with waits refuses a wait that names an unknown command or carries an id

mutations.name: the CLI ignores --top
kills: titan-console perf waits prints the top N from the day files, most owner time first
